hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git +(checkout +--|restore|reset +--hard|clean +-[a-z]*f)'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive git on a dirty tree discards unrecoverable work. Use `git stash push -m "<reason>"` instead, then report the stash name.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if ! make check >/tmp/tango-check.log 2>&1; then echo 'Blocked: make check is failing, so this commit would land on a red build. See /tmp/tango-check.log' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
